limitations: Fixed budget subset of 3 official selected tasks, selected for local execution and metadata coverage before model scoring; no claim of reproducing the paper leaderboard.
No task-score tuning on this suite. Task 283 shares a planning server family with development task 139, so this is not an independent task-family holdout.
TOOL coverage consists of relevant optional additions; no mandatory renamed/removed tool is tested. PARAM and DESC affect required tools. Coverage does not imply a model used every changed tool.
Task 133 Middle adds optional inputs; Late requires allow_variables. Changed does not necessarily mean old knowledge always fails.
Task 235 returns vis-chart specifications under the archived default implementation. This is retention of tool behavior, not verification of a hosted or browser-rendered dashboard.

Known archived-server defects are retained for every method: parallel-thinking completed-path output schema; Late sequentialthinking missing getThoughtHistory; Late batch_evaluate missing handleBatchEvaluate. Do not attribute these automatically to under/over-update.

Full Rewrite regenerates all target descriptions using the fixed model and rebuilds structural fields from target metadata; Selective Patch copies affected target records deterministically. Scope and generation mechanism both differ.
Three repeats preferred; one explicitly supported. Five judge ratings per trajectory do not measure agent-run variability.
Native stdio harness, fixed namespacing, workspace isolation and current pinned MCP SDK are common to all methods and differ from the paper HTTP harness.
Under/over-update case studies need actual trajectories plus causal review. A low score or tool error alone does not satisfy this report requirement.

Judge JSON object response mode added after an unscored v1 measurement trial produced truncated/repetitive rationales. Same rubric/model/temperature; five frozen prompts passed format preflight. Original failures retained; this is measurement-protocol debugging, not held-out judge validation.

v1.1 experienced a complete provider connection outage. v1.2 adds billed endpoint preflight and stops after two consecutive transport-failed cells; keeps failed records and unstarted cells separately. Preflight usage is separate in preflight/*.json.
